description: Report how AI crawlers and agents see a page: robots.txt per AI bot (search, user fetches, training) and Content-Signal, firewall blocks found by fetching with bot User-Agents, text present without JavaScript, what survives Markdown conversion, title/first paragraph/facts/noindex/canonical/sitemap, hidden instructions, and llms.txt, .md URLs, Accept: text/markdown, Link headers, ard.json. Each check is pass/warn/fail/info with a fix; robots.txt and header fixes include the changed file. Use it to tell a site owner why assistants can’t read or cite a page and what to change.

url.description: A site or any page on it, e.g. "example.com" or "docs.example.com/guide". The scheme is optional.

name: agent_view
title: What AI agents see on a page
